title: Show HN: Fly – A global load balancer with middleware

items.summary: Fly is cool and useful for app routing and middleware.
Pricing is too high for many users, potentially pricing out large customers.
How Fly is running on Kubernetes and the number of clusters.
Serving the site from Fastly edge servers instead of Fly's own infrastructure.
Comparison with Fastly and API gateway features.
SSH is not ideal for bulk traffic transfer due to buffer size limitations.
